_why: The practice locations in one place, read by the build for the LocalBusiness/Dentist JSON-LD (telephone, address, hasMap, areaServed) and by nothing else. Search Readiness item c3: a local business node without a phone and a map link is not read by the local pack.
_source: Street address and telephone for each location were read on 2026-11-03 from the practice's approved external booking page (data/system/booking_links.json -> defaultBookingUrl), which publishes them as facility data. The same addresses already appear in the site footer. Nothing here is estimated; if a location's details change, re-read that page.
_noGeoWhy: No latitude/longitude: coordinates were not published by that source, and an estimated coordinate is an invented fact. hasMap is built from the verified postal address instead.
_areaServedWhy: Only the two places the site itself says Dr. Brown sees patients. Nearby towns are not added: an areaServed the site does not claim in its own copy would be an unsupported claim.
